title: Summer campain
brief:
Aud: finance mid size 
Objective: to be seen in the mid size finance comapnies in LATAM

plan.rationale: Default plan for campaign-plan (logic tree, then campaign plan with A/B test design). I added two tasks. The brief targets "finance mid size" in "LATAM", but every approved claim and all segment evidence in the product file covers UK and EU finance only, so I added a job-ad ICP research task for LATAM mid-size finance first, and a positioning task for that segment, because the campaign plan needs messages from a positioning asset and the existing UK/EU positioning (r-20261029-generic-one-pager-for-uk-and-eu-finance-platform--t1) is for a different region and not yet approved. Gaps for Islam: the objective "to be seen" is awareness with no KPI or target, the brief gives no budget, dates or channels, and "summer" is ambiguous for LATAM (southern-hemisphere summer is December to February). LATAM is outside the locked UK/EU bet, so treat this as an exploratory plan.

tasks.title: Find and rank mid-size finance ICPs in LATAM from public job ads
tasks.note: Added: the product file has no LATAM evidence; the brief names LATAM mid-size finance.
